scope: One sequential full replay per method and scene, fixed saved RGB-D/masks and UFM revision; camera, SAM, GUI and disk I/O excluded. Unit: milliseconds per frame for all objects together. No independent pose labels for own demos.

processing.excludes: disk input/output, scoring, playback, camera capture and display
